# Cave Shake / Space Shake

> The story of Cave Shake, the keto, paleo, vegan dessert shake from Shark Tank Season 10, Episode 4 (2018), now called Space Shake. Founded by best friends Billie Cavallaro and Holly Heath; they made a $250,000 deal with guest Shark Charles Barkley.

## Key facts

- Cave Shake was one of the first keto products on the market: a dessert shake made with organic coconut milk. Keto, paleo, vegan, dairy-free, gluten-free.
- It launched in Los Angeles and sold out almost immediately, bootstrapped, with retail presence by late 2015 (including Belcampo Meat Co. on 3rd St).
- After Shark Tank (Season 10, Episode 4, 2018), Cave Shake rebranded to Space Shake. Packaging evolved from the original large glass jars to smaller plastic jars and then pouches; the recipe was never reformulated.
- The founders later launched Keto Space Bites.
- Billie Cavallaro is now a product designer; Holly Heath is on LinkedIn.
